# CleaningDigital

> Web design, local SEO, AI SEO, Google Ads and digital marketing exclusively for cleaning companies. Focused on Calgary, Alberta, and working remotely with cleaning company owners across Canada and the United States. Founder and Lead Strategist: Nakul Chandra.

- [Pricing](https://cleanningdigital.com/pricing.html): Three fixed one-time website packages: $490, $650 and $780
- [Our work](https://cleanningdigital.com/projects.html): Homepage designs built for cleaning companies
